“这是我家传的古画，已经传了好几代了，最近家里事情多，急用钱，就想着把它出手，换点钱周转一下。”画卷全部展开，秦思源开口说道。

对于他的话，张军只是笑了笑，没有接话，古玩城的故事多了，谁信谁是傻子。

张军仔细打量着展开的画卷，这是一幅仕女图，画卷上的仕女身着明朝服饰，眉眼温婉，身姿窈窕，笔触细腻，色彩虽有些暗淡，却依旧能看出当年的艳丽，画风古朴，看着倒真像是一幅古画。

可他毕竟只是店里的伙计，跟着李叔学了几年，辨认普通字画还行，碰到这种看着颇为珍贵的古画，他也拿不准真假，更不敢轻易做主收下。

更何况，李叔不在店里，没有老板的吩咐，他哪里敢擅自收这么一件不明来历的物件。

吴姜也在一旁凝神打量着画作，趁张军和秦思源不注意，默念口诀，阴阳眼悄然开启。

这下，吴姜心中了然了。

张军看了许久，又伸手轻轻摸了摸画卷的纸质，这才直起身，转头对秦思源说道：“先生，您这画看着倒是不错，像是古物，但我也拿不准真假，这样吧，您先报个价，我给老板打个电话，把情况跟他说说，让他来定夺，您看行吗？”

秦思源深吸一口气，沉吟片刻后，开口报出了价格：“五十万！我这画，最少五十万才卖！这可是明朝时期的仕女图，要不是手头紧张，我说什么也不舍得出手的！”

张军脸上依旧带着笑容，没有丝毫讨价还价的意思：“好的先生，我知道了，我这就给我们老板打电话。”说完，他拿出手机，拨通了李叔的电话。

此时，李叔正和吴时安一起，在泾县一家宣纸作坊里挑选宣纸。

接到张军的电话，顿时来了兴致，没想到，出门在外，还能碰到这么一笔买卖。

“视频给我，我先看看。”李叔的声音从电话里传来。他做书画生意几十年了，眼光毒辣，就算是不上手，也能看个大差不差。

张军连忙应下，挂断电话，拨通了李叔的视频通话，将手机对准了桌上的仕女图。

李叔目光紧紧盯着屏幕里的画作，眼神专注，还不时的让张军挪动位置，最后，又仔细看起了画上的铃印。

看了足足几分钟，李叔才缓缓收回目光，眼底闪过一丝喜色，对着视频那头的张军说道：“将电话给秦先生吧，我们来谈谈价格！”

秦思源接过手机，“老板，我说过了，最低五十万，低于这个数，我是不卖的。”

Chapter 27 Ancient Painting 2-"The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

"This is an ancient painting passed down from my family. It has been passed down for several generations. There have been a lot of things at home recently and I am in urgent need of money, so I thought of selling it to get some money for turnover." Qin Siyuan opened the scroll and said.

In response to his words, Zhang Jun just smiled and did not answer. There are many stories in the Antique City, and anyone who believes them is a fool.

Zhang Jun carefully looked at the unfolded scroll. It was a picture of a lady. The lady on the scroll was dressed in Ming Dynasty clothes. She had gentle eyebrows, a graceful figure, and delicate brushstrokes. Although the color was a bit dim, she could still see the beauty of the year. The painting style was simple, and it really looked like an ancient painting.

But after all, he was just a clerk in the store. He had studied with Uncle Li for several years and was good at identifying ordinary calligraphy and paintings. But when he came across such precious ancient paintings, he was not sure whether they were genuine or not, and he didn't dare to accept them easily.

What's more, Uncle Li is not in the store, and there is no way he would dare to collect such an item of unknown origin without the boss's instructions.

Wu Jiang was also looking at the painting attentively. When Zhang Jun and Qin Siyuan were not paying attention, he silently recited the mantra and quietly opened his yin and yang eyes.

Now, Wu Jiang understood clearly.

Zhang Jun looked at it for a long time, then reached out and gently touched the paper of the scroll. Then he straightened up, turned to Qin Siyuan and said: "Sir, your painting looks good, like an ancient relic, but I am not sure whether it is authentic or not. How about this? You quote a price first, and I will call the boss and tell him the situation and let him make a decision. Do you think it's okay?"

Qin Siyuan took a deep breath, pondered for a moment, and then quoted the price: "Fifty million! I will sell this painting for at least 500,000! This is a painting of a lady from the Ming Dynasty. If money hadn't been tight, I wouldn't have sold it at all!"

Zhang Jun still had a smile on his face, without any intention of bargaining: "Okay sir, I understand, I will call our boss right away." After saying that, he took out his mobile phone and dialed Uncle Li's number.

At this time, Li Shuzheng and Wu Shi'an were selecting rice paper in a rice paper workshop in Jingxian County.

When I received Zhang Jun's call, I immediately became interested. I didn't expect that I would come across such a deal while away from home.

"Give me the video. I'll take a look first." Uncle Li's voice came from the phone.He has been in the calligraphy and painting business for decades, and he has a sharp eye. Even if he is not familiar with it, he can still see a big difference.

Zhang Jun quickly agreed, hung up the phone, dialed Uncle Li's video call, and pointed his phone at the picture of the lady on the table.

Uncle Li stared at the painting on the screen, his eyes focused, and asked Zhang Jun to move his position from time to time. Finally, he looked carefully at the bell mark on the painting.

After watching it for a few minutes, Uncle Li slowly looked away, a hint of joy flashed in his eyes, and said to Zhang Jun on the other end of the video: "Give Mr. Qin the phone number, and let's talk about the price!"

Qin Siyuan took the phone and said, "Boss, I told you, the minimum is 500,000. I won't sell it below this amount."
